raw: {"analysis": "TBV better addresses the urgency by proposing to avoid the 48-hour security review if possible (via environment variables) and explicitly plans to start the review early if unavoidable, while HWJ assumes the config change is necessary and schedules it as a bottleneck. TBV also includes a manual emergency bypass with CTO approval, which directly supports the override requirement, and emphasizes cost control by triggering the expensive ledger CI only once after verification. HWJ offers a solid feature-flag rollout and detailed review strategy, but its acceptance of the 48-hour delay and lack of a manual fallback make it less responsive to the 'stop the bleeding immediately' priority.", "verdict": "TBV"}
